description: This file defines API route handlers for managing notes in a web application. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, utilizing FastAPI and SQLAlchemy. It also contains internal helper functions for fetching notes or raising 404 errors.

methods.name: Note _get_note_or_404(db: Session, note_id: int)
methods.description: Internal helper function to retrieve a note by ID or raise 404 if not found.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note(payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new note with a title and optional content.

methods.name: List[NoteOut] list_notes( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search substring for title/content"), db: Session = Depends(get_session), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list all notes, with optional search filtering.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a single note by its ID.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note( note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_session) )
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing note's title or content.

methods.name: None delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a note by its ID.
